entries.title: I Chronicles 19:2
segments: Gratitude should ever be manifested for favors; and if it cannot be shown towards the benefactors themselves, it should be towards their children or others who were connected with them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:3
segments: Our best intentions may be misunderstood and misrepresented; evil may be returned for good, and that which should have been the means of forming and cementing friendship, may be made the occasion of enmity and strife.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:13
segments: In a good cause, men should be of good courage; and while they use with fidelity all appointed means, they should feel their dependence on God, and commit the result of their efforts to him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:18
segments: All efforts of the wicked to prevail against God and his people will in the end prove ineffectual, and be the means of hastening and aggravating their own ruin.
